raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane domain outline and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sections 2.1 and 3.1 delegate the geometry to Fig. 1(a). Section 2.3 specifies 100×100 finite elements, which does not establish physical bounding dimensions L and H or the domain outline.",
      "readings": [
        "Full rectangular domain with L/H=1.",
        "Full rectangular domain with L/H=2.",
        "A tapered cantilever region within a rectangular background grid, with root height H and tip height H/2."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute geometric scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No physical length or length unit is given. This ambiguity concerns a geometrically similar problem with mesh-relative boundary conditions and filter dimensions preserved.",
      "readings": [
        "Use L=1 m and scale all geometric lengths consistently.",
        "Use L=0.1 m and scale all geometric lengths consistently."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The cantilever description gives no thickness or statement that compliance is evaluated per unit thickness. For a fixed 2D idealization and prescribed resultant forces, uniform thickness changes scale compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit thickness.",
        "Use a uniform thickness of 1 mm.",
        "Use a uniform thickness of 10 mm."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Location of the cantilever root",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The word 'cantilever' identifies a built-in root qualitatively, but Sections 2.1 and 3.1 do not identify its side; they refer to Fig. 1(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Root at x=0.",
        "Root at x=L.",
        "Root at y=0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Nodes or segments attached to the root clamp",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "No supported node set or supported edge interval is written. For a root at x=0, the extent of the attachment therefore remains unresolved.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix both in-plane translations at every node on x=0.",
        "Fix both translations only at the two corner nodes (0,0) and (0,H).",
        "Fix both translations on root patches 0≤y≤0.1H and 0.9H≤y≤H."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Cantilever load location",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sections 2.1 and 3.1 provide no force coordinates or loaded boundary. For a root at x=0, the position must be recovered from the unavailable Fig. 1(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Load centered at the free-edge midpoint (L,H/2).",
        "Load at the free-edge corner (L,0).",
        "Load centered on the upper edge at (L/2,H)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the prescribed load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "No nodal force pattern, loaded edge length, or traction profile is written for the cantilever.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force at one node.",
        "A uniform traction over the entire free edge, normalized to a specified total force.",
        "A uniform traction over the central 10% of the free edge, normalized to the same total force."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of cantilever loading",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The text identifies constant loading but gives no force components or angle. Taking x along the beam, several directions remain possible.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse downward loading: direction (0,-1).",
        "Axial loading: direction (1,0).",
        "Oblique loading: direction (1,-1)/sqrt(2)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Overall force amplitude",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No cantilever force magnitude or force unit appears in Sections 2.1, 2.3, 3.1, or the supplied captions. This item concerns uniform scaling of the prescribed loading.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant force of 1 N.",
        "Total resultant force of 1000 N."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "Load-case count and compliance aggregation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The cantilever description does not state how many load cases are solved or whether different forces act simultaneously. Constant loading does not determine this grouping.",
      "readings": [
        "One static load case.",
        "Transverse and axial forces acting simultaneously in one case.",
        "Separate transverse and axial cases, minimizing their equally weighted mean compliance."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Fixed-solid and fixed-void element masks",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sections 2.1, 2.3, and 3.1 do not say whether every element is designable or identify any passive regions.",
      "readings": [
        "All 100×100 elements are designable.",
        "One element column adjacent to a left root is held solid.",
        "A solid loading pad occupies the last two columns and the central ten rows.",
        "A central 10×10 element block is held void."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume fraction of the specific target in Fig. 3(b)",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 2.3 specifies a family from 0.01 to 0.95 in steps of 0.01, and Table 1 identifies four tested fractions. Neither Section 3.1 nor the Fig. 3 caption selects the fraction represented by Fig. 3(b).",
      "readings": [
        "Vf=0.03.",
        "Vf=0.25.",
        "Vf=0.50.",
        "Vf=0.75.",
        "Another member of the stated 0.01-spaced grid from 0.01 through 0.95."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Reference volume and passive-region accounting",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 2.3 gives fraction values without defining their denominator or how passive material would enter the budget. These distinctions matter if the domain is masked or contains passive regions.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain total material, including passive solids, to Vf times the bounding-rectangle volume.",
        "Apply Vf only to the designable region, with passive solids outside that budget.",
        "Normalize total material by the actual admissible beam-domain volume, excluding exterior masked cells."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Elastic constitutive matrix and 2D idealization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper prints no constitutive matrix or plane-stress/plane-strain assumption for the cantilever. Naming top88 does not supply these definitions within the provided text.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane-stress elasticity.",
        "Isotropic plane-strain elasticity."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Overall solid stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No solid Young's modulus is given. With Poisson's ratio and all stiffness ratios held fixed, changing this overall scale only rescales compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "E0=1 in consistent nondimensional units.",
        "E0=210 GPa, with the same dimensionless void-to-solid stiffness ratio."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is stated in the cantilever description or the top88 inputs listed in Section 2.3.",
      "readings": [
        "nu=0.20.",
        "nu=0.30.",
        "nu=0.45."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Void stiffness and density-to-stiffness interpolation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 2.3 fixes penal=3 but does not print the interpolation equation or the minimum stiffness used to represent void.",
      "readings": [
        "E(rho)=Emin+(E0-Emin)rho^3 with Emin/E0=1e-9.",
        "E(rho)=Emin+(E0-Emin)rho^3 with Emin/E0=1e-3.",
        "E(rho)=E0 rho^3 with a positive density lower bound of 1e-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Minimum design density",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The listed top88 inputs do not state whether densities may reach zero or are bounded away from zero.",
      "readings": [
        "0≤rho≤1, with positive ersatz stiffness.",
        "1e-6≤rho≤1.",
        "1e-3≤rho≤1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 2.3 fixes the element counts at 100×100 but does not describe element order, shape functions, or integration.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with full 2×2 Gauss integration.",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with stabilized reduced integration.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with full integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Physical node spacing on the structured grid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 100×100 counts and image dimensions do not explicitly give physical node coordinates or require uniform spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform spacing: x_i=L i/100 and y_j=H j/100.",
        "A graded structured grid: x_i=L(i/100)^2 and y_j=H j/100."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units and distance metric of rmin",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Section 2.3 unambiguously gives rmin=2.4, but provides no length convention or distance metric for reproducing that setting in another solver.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius 2.4 in Euclidean element-index coordinates.",
        "Radius 2.4 in physical length units, using physical centroid distances.",
        "Physical radius 2.4 times the horizontal element pitch."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Mathematical implementation of the selected ft=1 filter",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Section 2.3 fixes ft=1 but supplies no filter equation, kernel, density weighting, or small-density denominator guard. The implementation is delegated to code whose contents are not provided.",
      "readings": [
        "Conical weights max(0,rmin-d_ij), density-weighted sensitivities, and denominator max(rho_i,1e-3) times the weight sum.",
        "The same conical sensitivity filter with denominator guard 1e-6.",
        "Uniform sensitivity averaging over neighbors within rmin."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain and mask boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No topology-optimization filter boundary rule is printed. The padding described in Section 2.2 concerns the CNN and does not define this rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the neighborhood to valid domain cells and renormalize retained weights.",
        "Use zero values outside the domain with full-kernel normalization.",
        "Reflect the density or sensitivity field across the boundary."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization update rule and numerical controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper names top88 but prints no update equation, move limit, damping, multiplier-search tolerance, or account of local changes. These affect reproduction of a nonconvex optimization trajectory.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria update with move limit 0.2, damping exponent 0.5, and relative multiplier tolerance 1e-3.",
        "Optimality-criteria update with move limit 0.1, damping exponent 0.5, and relative multiplier tolerance 1e-6.",
        "MMA update with move limit 0.2 and initial asymptote distance 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial design",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sections 2.1, 2.3, and 3.1 do not specify the initial density field or any random seed. Different initializations can select different local solutions.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density rho=Vf on designable cells.",
        "A volume-preserving random perturbation of amplitude 0.001 around Vf, using seed 0 and respecting density bounds."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Cantilever stopping criterion and iteration cap",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No convergence tolerance or iteration cap is assigned to top88. The maxit=100 setting in Section 2.3 belongs to TOPress, not the cantilever.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when the maximum element-density change is below 0.01, without a fixed iteration cap.",
        "Stop when the maximum element-density change is below 0.001 or after 1000 iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
